title: CAFE: Closed-Loop Autonomous Task Formulation and Execution without Instance-Specific Instructions
description:
arXiv:2611.12983v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Scene-driven robot autonomy requires selecting tasks from observations as well as executing them. We study scene-driven task formulation and execution under predefined cleaning, safety, and storage/organization categories, without instance-specific goals or action sequences. CAFE maintains online memory of objects, functional zones, and execution states. A rule-guided Trigger-LLM admits formulation from accumulated evidence; Draft, Complete, and A
